# Summary

Provide a clear and concise description of the documentation issue.

## Type of Documentation Issue

- [ ] Missing documentation
- [ ] Incorrect information
- [ ] Outdated information
- [ ] Typo or grammar issue
- [ ] Unclear explanation
- [ ] Missing examples
- [ ] Broken links
- [ ] Other

## Location

Specify where the issue occurs.

Examples:

- README.md
- CONTRIBUTING.md
- Extension API documentation
- User guide
- Tutorials
- Website

## Current Content

Describe the existing content or explain what is missing.

## Suggested Improvement

Describe what should be added, corrected, or clarified.

## Examples or References

Provide links, examples, screenshots, or additional resources that may help.

## Additional Information

Add any other context that may be useful.

## Checklist

- [ ] I have searched existing issues and discussions.
- [ ] This issue has not already been reported.
- [ ] I have provided enough information to explain the problem.
